sources.title: Home - Kroma
sources.snippet: Kroma flips that — you describe what you need, and the AI builds the whole deck. Content, layout, visuals, everything. You start by editing a finished product, not building one from scratch. Real content. Kroma uses GPT-4o with a system prompt tuned for presentation design — visual hierarchy, narrative flow, content density.
